verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents built-in progress-reporting views. Hill Charts show where work stands, and Everything Views pull items of one type from every project onto a single page. Nothing in the evidence shows a PM can build or customize dashboards or add widgets, so only the 'report on project progress' half of the story is covered, through fixed views. Missing for 10: user-buildable or configurable dashboards, a widget library or layout customization, cross-project progress dashboards with metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: Basecamp’s Hill Charts let you know exactly where things really stand.
Everything Views pull everything of one type onto a single page, no matter which project it’s in.
See overlaps, see beginnings and ends, see who’s on what, even see key dates superimposed over everything.
